name: Leyline Conduit procs on harmful spells (#12334, #12464, #12542)
contract: #12334, #12464, #12542: Leyline Conduit (proc dummies 355105) never procced. Every dummy carries Spell.dbc
ProcFlags 0 and the world had no spell_proc row, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped it. Tooltip: "Your
harmful spells have a chance". Stock records with that sentence (64714, 38319, 65005, 37295, 37619) carry
ProcFlags 65536 in Spell.dbc; the same flags are used. No cooldown in the tooltip. spell_proc_chance reads
each loaded entry's chance, which equals the record's ProcChance, and spell_proc_cooldown_ms reads each
loaded cooldown. aura_proc_rate replays the aura's native proc decision, including the roll, 40000 times on
one synthetic event per check. It procs on a landed direct magic spell (Frostbolt 116), at the record's
chance; it never procs on a wand shot (Shoot 5019), a landed melee ability (Heroic Strike 78), a periodic
Shadow tick (Shadow Word: Pain 589). Before the repair the chance and cooldown lookups fail with 'Spell has
no proc entry' and every rate reads 0, so the discriminating checks fail instead of flaking.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
DISCRIMINATING: a landed direct magic spell (Frostbolt 116) procs 355105 at 9%
CONTROL: a wand shot (Shoot 5019) procs 355105 at 0%
CONTROL: a landed melee ability (Heroic Strike 78) procs 355105 at 0%
CONTROL: a periodic Shadow tick (Shadow Word: Pain 589) procs 355105 at 0%
